title: Vibe Coding for Designers: From Figma to Live App in an Afternoon
summary: Designers are uniquely positioned for vibe coding—you already think in components and UX flows. Here's how to go from mockup to shipped product without a developer.
body_markdown: This happens. Sometimes you go in circles trying to fix something that isn't quite right. Two moves that work: describe what's wrong specifically ("the user can submit the form without filling in the email field") rather than "fix the bug." Or zoom out and rebuild the broken section from scratch with a cleaner prompt. Sometimes the right call is to accept that a particular feature isn't happening today and move on.
